wiring.PIN_25: Pico GP12 input-only with serialized pull-down/pull-up

safety: Every FPGA image was statically incapable of driving high: A had no data/OE port; B/C/D data was an exact local zero. Pico GP12 remained input-only for the whole campaign; only GP4 was driven, starting low. Cleanup executed Pico ALLIN then AG32 reset halt/run. No flash command exists in the runner.

static_audit.requirements: ordinary release-strict first-seed builds; fresh repack byte-identical; total=mapped; zero unmapped, predicted, and legacy-absolute selectors; exact two-pip PIN_25 input corridor in A/C/D; exact six-pip dynamic-OE corridor in C/D; local-zero data in B/C/D

meaning: The combined PIN_25 cell changes the external line from the scalar-input composition's persistent high/readback-low state to persistent low/readback-high, but toggling the fully routed EN control has no observable effect. The scalar constant-low control also remains high because a scalar constant output does not activate this combined physical site. This distinguishes a combined-site mode/OE defect from a dead input/readback path, but does not yet distinguish wrong OE polarity from a constant-enable packer/config mode or missing electrical-mode bit.
claim_boundary: Do not promote PIN_25 dynamic OE, release, open-drain, or bidirectional behavior. Preserve existing scalar PIN_25 input and nonconstant scalar-output qualifications: this negative is limited to these exact scalar-constant and combined-cell compositions. The retained vendor OE corridors remain topology evidence only.
next_experiment: Offline vendor-vs-open differential at X0Y4_IOB0 and config tile (0,4): combined IOB mode/electrical preamble bits, IOMUX06 terminal/source selection, and exact EN corridor selector ownership. Only after that produces a single-variable causal A/B may another board token be requested.

wiring.PIN_25: Pico GP12 input-only with serialized pull-down/pull-up

safety: Both images retain an exact local hard-zero pad-data source, so they can only release PIN_25 or drive it low. GP12 and GP8 remained input-only; no Pico GPIO was configured as an output. Cleanup executed Pico ALLIN then AG32 reset halt/run. No flash command exists in the runner.

static_audit.requirements: deep JSON equality after changing only INIT; exact D/readback placement and routes retained; 35/35 mapped; zero unmapped, predicted, and legacy-absolute selectors; local-zero data; complete six-pip OE corridor retained

meaning: With every IOB mode, input-sense bit, pad-data source, placement, and route held constant, changing only the OE-source LUT from constant zero to constant one changes PIN_25 from released/high to driven low, and the fabric readback changes consistently. OE polarity is therefore source 0 = released and source 1 = drive-low. The combined PIN_25 input sensing and complete X10Y4-to-X0Y4 OE corridor work on silicon.
claim_boundary: Qualifies the exact PIN_25 combined-cell constant release/drive-low compositions and simultaneous input readback through the recorded corridor. It does not yet qualify dynamic OE driven through the ordinary external PIN_10 ingress: that route produced a constant-low pad for both commanded values and remains unqualified. It does not generalize to other pins, corridors, electrical modes, registered OE, or open-drain.
correction: This causal A/B supersedes the prior record's live hypothesis that combined-site mode, CFG_INPUT_EN interaction, OE polarity, or the OE terminal might explain the negative. All are exonerated in this exact composition. The remaining cause is upstream of X10Y4_SLICE0 in the external PIN_10 ingress route.
next_experiment: Prepare a local self-toggling OE source at X10Y4_SLICE0 through the same exact six-pip corridor, statically prove zero selector debt and electrical safety, then request a separate board token. Independently isolate the ordinary PIN_10-to-X10Y4 mesh route before claiming external-control dynamic OE.

wiring.PIN_25: Pico GP12 input-only with serialized pull-down/pull-up

safety: The routed image has an exact local hard-zero pad-data source, so dynamic OE can only alternate PIN_25 between release and drive-low; it cannot drive high. GP12 and GP8 remained input-only and no Pico GPIO was configured as an output. Cleanup executed Pico ALLIN then AG32 reset halt/run. No flash command exists in the runner.

static_audit.requirements: ordinary release-strict first-seed build; fresh repack byte-identical; 41/41 mapped; zero unmapped, predicted, and legacy-absolute selectors; exact local data-low; exact PIN_25 input corridor; exact six-pip OE corridor; qualified direct-feedback TFF and dedicated clock; qualified PIN_18 output
static_audit.topology: X14Y11 direct-feedback TFF -> transparent X10Y4_SLICE0 presentation -> X10Y4_OMUX02 -> X10Y4_RMUX08 -> X11Y4_RMUX26 -> X8Y4_RMUX13 -> X4Y4_RMUX49 -> X0Y4_RMUX00 -> X0Y4_IOMUX06

meaning: PIN_25 has no transitions with an external pull-down, but produces 61,334 transitions in 29.473 ms with a pull-up (~1.04 MHz square-wave rate). Since the FPGA data value is always zero, only alternating release and drive-low can produce this pull-dependent result. This is silicon proof of dynamic OE through the exact recorded combined-cell corridor. GP8 produced zero edges under both pulls, so the simultaneous high-rate fabric readback path is not qualified by this run.
claim_boundary: Promote only PIN_25 dynamic release/drive-low through the exact local-self-toggle and six-pip OE composition. The prior constant-source A/B separately qualifies static simultaneous input readback. Do not promote simultaneous dynamic readback, external PIN_10-controlled OE, registered OE, open-drain, another pin/corridor, or a generic bidirectional interface.
next_experiment: For dynamic readback, construct a rate-divided or slow stepped OE source while retaining the exact input and PIN_18 paths, with an independent direct pad observation. For external control, isolate the ordinary PIN_10-to-X10Y4 ingress route by a single-route A/B; do not revisit the already-proven combined IOB mode or OE terminal.

meaning: The ordinary PCF flow now inserts the silicon-qualified X19Y12 entry identity for PIN10-controlled PIN25 OE. Under both Pico pulls, PIN10 low releases PIN25 to the board's established high bias and PIN10 high drives PIN25 low. In the simultaneous readback image GP8 reproduces PIN10 exactly while GP12 is complementary, proving dynamic OE and fabric sensing in the same stepped composition. The scalar constant-output image remains a retained non-conducting negative and is not promoted.
claim_boundary: Qualifies only external PIN10-controlled dynamic release/drive-low and simultaneous stepped PIN25 readback through the exact recorded L48 production composition. It does not qualify generic PIN10 fanout, the divergent RMUX20 branch, constant scalar PIN25 output, active drive-high, open-drain electrical mode, registered OE, other pins, corridors, or packages.
supersedes: Supersedes only the first record's external-control and simultaneous-dynamic-readback negative for the new exact production route. It does not erase that image's result or the scalar constant-output negative.
